title: ActivityDefinitionSchema
description: Defines an Activity Definition, as accepted by POST /api/v1alpha1/activity-definitions

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema of the values the activity reads. Its required fields must be provided by the orchestrations that use the activity

outputSchema.description: JSON Schema of the values the activity provides to the activities that depend on it

NamespaceType.description: Optional. Must be the namespace of the request if given
